# The KettleBelle

> > Kettlebell training and strength coaching for women, founded by Faith Ellis, featuring home workouts, nutrition guidance, and online coaching through the Howdy App.

The KettleBelle specializes in beginner-friendly kettlebell programs designed specifically for busy women training at home. Faith Ellis, an ACE CPT and NESTA Kettlebell Certified coach based in Burlington, NC, offers personalized coaching, functional fitness routines, and nutrition support focused on sustainable strength building and hormone balance.

## Key Topics

- Kettlebell training for women
- Strength training fundamentals
- Home workouts and functional fitness
- Beginner-friendly programming
- Women's fitness and hormone balance
- Nutrition guidance and meal planning
- Low-impact strength training
- Cortisol management and recovery
- Online coaching via Howdy App
- Faith Ellis - Founder and Coach
- Minimalist training approach
- Mobility and functional strength
- Kettlebell form and technique
- Fitness trends for women
